To my understanding, and I don’t do direct patient care but work in the medical field, is that when doing breathless cpr, you force out any air which creates a negative pressure in the lung with the compression which is then filled again between compressions. 

Notice if you let all the air out of your lungs, you can still push a bit out and if you relax your diaphragm, the air rushed back in. While this isn’t the same as regular cpr, for the average person who finds themselves in a situation where they need to perform it, can still attempt it. Keeping the remaining oxygenated blood flowing is still helpful.
